name: business-logic
description: Convert a product request into explicit rules, states, permissions, exceptions, and verifiable acceptance criteria.

name: catch-up
description: Reconstruct the current project state, completed work, blockers, and next action.

name: core-thinking
description: Analyze goals, constraints, risks, and evidence before execution.

name: daily-harvest
description: Turn everything the inbox and the daily folder hold - sessions from every AI client, imported memories, candidates, corrections - into filed knowledge and a better system, with no manual review, then archive. Use when the owner says harvest, process the inbox, file everything, improve the knowledge, or clean up 00-inbox and 01-daily.

name: design-thinking
description: Frame a problem, clarify the desired outcome, compare simple solutions, and define success before implementation.

name: graft
description: This repo is indexed by graft/. For ANY task here, whether understanding how something works, finding where code lives, tracing what calls a symbol or what a change breaks, or scoping an edit, get your context from graft before grepping or reading source files.

name: loop
description: Continue a bounded task across runs with checkpoints, verification, retries, and explicit stop conditions.

name: memory-review
description: Review pending memory candidates with the owner one at a time - compare each with the record it would change, recommend, and merge approved facts cleanly into that record. Use when he says review candidates, review my memory, go through the proposals, or clear the inbox candidates.

name: ocean-memory
description: The user's memory lives in Ocean, a local memory system on their own computer, reached through the ocean MCP tools (brain_search, brain_read, memory_propose). Use this skill whenever the user asks where their memory is stored, what you remember about them, what you know about their projects, tasks, code, people, preferences or past decisions, or says "my", "our", "remember", "last time", "as before". Ocean is the authority; your built-in memory is not a second store but a copy that Ocean captures.

name: session-handoff
description: Produce a compact continuation packet with the next action and verification commands.

name: use-browser
description: Open a supplied URL, understand the user's requested outcome from the live page, complete the browser task, and verify the result.

name: verification
description: Turn implementation claims into focused, repeatable verification checks.

name: weekly-review
description: Walk the owner through the week to inbox zero - the weekly digest, pending memory candidates, inbox captures and unsorted notes - deciding each item with him.
